The original title promised joint spectrum but the Statement and all five proof steps construct a joint PVM, maximal coordinate multipliers and exact derivative domains, without defining or proving a spectrum-set characterization. Dereziński §1.5 (1.16) is the missing neighborhood criterion. Retitled joint spectral measure; all actual claims, formulas and prerequisites remain intact.
